Ondo Finance’s Total Value Locked Surpasses $4 Billion, with Over 1 Million Holders

The tokenization of real-world assets continues to gain momentum, and Ondo Finance is one of the most closely watched platforms in the sector. According to Foresight News, Ondo Finance officially announced that the platform’s total value locked has surpassed $4 billion. Its assets span tokenized Treasuries, stocks, ETFs, portfolios, and private markets. Tokenized stocks and ETFs account for more than $1.3 billion, and the platform’s products have more than 1 million holders in total. The project attributes this growth to an innovative trading model: Ondo Stocks taps into the liquidity of traditional financial exchanges through a request-for-quote mechanism and supports permissionless transfers on Solana, Ethereum, and BNB Chain.

The $4 billion figure is not driven by a single product. In July this year, Ondo launched a tokenized stock offering that complies with the U.S. SEC’s third-party custody model. Its initial assets included BlackRock’s IVV ETF and Micron stock. The underlying securities remain within the traditional custody chain, while transfer agent Oasis Pro mints tokenized interests on Ethereum on a one-to-one basis. Broadridge provides proxy voting and shareholder communications, giving token holders the same governance rights as investors holding assets in traditional brokerage accounts. This compliant framework laid the groundwork for subsequent expansion. Earlier, Ondo Global Markets became the first tokenized stock and ETF platform to reach $1 billion in total value locked, doing so in less than eight months. The company says it holds more than 70% of the market in this segment, with cumulative trading volume exceeding $18 billion. The increase in stock-related assets from $1 billion to $1.3 billion suggests they are becoming a new growth engine.

The impact on crypto markets can be viewed through four channels. First, multichain deployment is driving on-chain activity and settlement demand on Solana, BNB Chain, and Ethereum. Second, by connecting to traditional exchange liquidity through its request-for-quote mechanism, the platform gives crypto wallet users more direct access to U.S. stocks and ETFs, allowing the two liquidity systems to begin channeling users to one another. Third, Citigroup previously forecast that the tokenized securities market could reach $5.5 trillion by 2030, and Ondo’s figures provide a real-world example supporting that narrative. Fourth, if the SEC’s third-party custody model becomes more firmly established, more issuers and intermediaries may adopt the same approach.

Facts should be distinguished from speculation. The $4 billion in total value locked, $1.3 billion in stocks and ETFs, and 1 million holders are figures reported by the project and covered by the media. Some can be verified on-chain, but it remains worth checking whether the methodology includes private-market valuations. Growth in total value locked does not necessarily correlate with token prices, and short-term sentiment may diverge from fundamentals. Ondo’s tokenized stock products were previously unavailable to U.S. investors, making the pace of regulatory progress a key variable going forward. In the editor’s view, competition in tokenization is shifting from whether assets can be issued to whether platforms can provide comprehensive governance rights and deep liquidity. Ondo is currently well positioned, but the entry of Robinhood, DTCC, and major exchanges will continue to raise the competitive bar.

真实世界资产代币化赛道持续升温，Ondo Finance是其中最受关注的平台之一。据Foresight News报道，Ondo Finance官方宣布平台总锁仓价值已突破40亿美元，资产覆盖代币化国债、股票、ETF、投资组合与私募市场，其中代币化股票与ETF规模超过13亿美元，全产品累计持有者超过100万。项目方将增长归因于交易方式创新：Ondo Stocks通过询价机制接入传统金融交易所流动性，并在Solana、Ethereum和BNB Chain上支持无许可转账。

从结构上看，40亿美元并非单一产品驱动。今年7月，Ondo推出符合美国SEC第三方托管模式的代币化股票方案，首批标的包括贝莱德IVV ETF与美光股票：底层证券留在传统托管链条中，由转让代理Oasis Pro在以太坊上按一比一铸造代币化权益，Broadridge提供代理投票与股东沟通服务，让代币持有人享有与传统经纪账户投资者相同的治理权利。这一合规框架构成此后扩张的基础。此前，Ondo Global Markets已成为首个总锁仓价值达到10亿美元的代币化股票与ETF平台，用时不到8个月，官方称其在该细分市场份额超过70%，累计成交额超过180亿美元。股票类资产从10亿到13亿美元的爬升，说明其正成为新的增长引擎。

对加密市场的影响可从四条路径观察：一是多链部署带动Solana、BNB Chain、Ethereum的链上活动与结算需求；二是询价机制打通传统交易所流动性后，加密钱包用户可更直接触达美股与ETF，两套流动性体系开始互相导流；三是花旗此前预测2030年代币化证券市场规模有望达到5.5万亿美元，Ondo的数据为这一叙事提供微观注脚；四是若SEC第三方托管模式进一步制度化，更多发行方与中介机构可能复制该路径。

以太坊在过去24小时内经历了更为剧烈的波动。受宏观通胀数据超预期和机构资金持续流出的双重压力，ETH一度跌至约2315美元，创下两个月以来的新低。在触及低点后，市场出现强力反弹，价格从最低点回升超过100美元，最新报价约2374美元，但24小时整体仍下跌约1.36%。

从小时K线来看，ETH在2324美元附近获得了明显的买盘支撑，该位置恰好是抛物线SAR指标的支撑位。随后价格连续收出两根大阳线，最新一根小时K线收盘价达到2431美元，最高触及2434美元，反弹幅度接近5%。成交量方面，反弹过程中两个小时的成交额分别达到7206万美元和7357万美元，显示资金入场意愿强烈。

二、技术指标解读

移动平均线系统显示，ETH当前仍处于空头排列之中。7周期均线位于2375美元，25周期均线位于2395美元，99周期均线位于2486美元，三条均线呈空头排列，对价格形成层层压制。价格虽然已经站上7周期均线，但要突破25周期和99周期均线仍需更强的多头力量。

MACD指标出现底部背离信号。DIF线从负值区域快速回升，MACD柱状图由负转正并扩大至7.47，虽然绝对值较小，但方向性转变明确。RSI指标从极度超卖区域（RSI6一度跌至24.51）快速反弹至73.03，已经进入相对高位，短线可能存在回调需求。

ETH市场当前面临多重压力。首先，美国现货以太坊ETF在10月14日录得1.295亿美元的净流出，机构资金持续撤离。其次，知名做市商Wintermute的做空头寸增加了市场抛压，一小时内ETH多头清算达到1.06亿美元，为近六个月最高。第三，VanEck撤回了其Lido质押ETH ETF的申请，打击了市场对质押类机构产品的信心。

What key upgrades has Ethereum made over the years?
On July 20, 2016, Ethereum hard-forked at block 1920000 to address The DAO incident. The original chain that did not follow the fork became Ethereum Classic (ETC). The Cancun upgrade (Dencun) on March 13, 2024, introduced blob data, significantly reducing the cost of submitting data from layer-2 networks to the mainnet.
In recent years, Ethereum’s upgrades have focused on a few areas: switching to proof of stake, improving the fee mechanism, and lowering data costs for layer-2 networks.
$ETH  has been Ethereum’s native coin for paying gas since the mainnet launched in 2015. Currently 2423.79.

#ETH

2016 年 7 月 20 日，以太坊在区块 1920000 做了硬分叉处理 The DAO 事件，没有跟随分叉的原链成了以太坊经典（ETC）。2024 年 3 月 13 日的坎昆升级（Dencun）引入了 blob 数据，二层网络往主网提交数据的成本大幅下降。
近几年以太坊的升级集中在几个方向：换成权益证明、改进手续费机制、压低二层网络的数据成本。

An NFT is a Non-Fungible Token. Each token has a unique identifier, so NFTs cannot be exchanged for one another on an equal basis.

title: USDT为什么能锚定1美元？稳定币的运转原理
subTitle:
玩合约离不开USDT，但很多朋友没想过它凭什么值1美元。

【原理】稳定币由发行方运营：你给它1美元，它发给你1个USDT，并把
美元（及等值资产）存进储备。市场上谁想把USDT换回美元，就向发行
方赎回。这套「申购-赎回」机制像锚一样，把价格钉在1美元附近。
价格偶尔偏离一点点（比如0.999），套利者马上搬砖抹平。

【要关心的风险】储备透明度。USDT定期公布储备报告（含美债等资产），
但历史上稳定币圈出过事——储备不够的稳定币脱锚崩掉，持有人血本
无归。所以：大额资金别长期躺在单一稳定币里，分散是免费的保险。

translatedData.subTitle:
It’s hard to trade futures without USDT, but many people have never wondered what makes it worth $1.

【How it works】A stablecoin is managed by its issuer: you give it $1, and it issues you 1 USDT, while placing
the dollar (and assets of equivalent value) into reserves. Anyone in the market who wants to exchange USDT back for dollars can contact the issuer
to the issuer for redemption. This “subscribe-redeem” mechanism acts like an anchor, keeping the price close to $1.
If the price occasionally deviates slightly (say, to $0.999), arbitrageurs quickly trade to bring it back in line.

translatedData.title: Lido brings four L2s under one roof: no more manually bridging back to mainnet to stake
translatedData.subTitle:
Previously, if you wanted to stake $ETH on Base or Arbitrum, you had to bridge it back to mainnet and then bridge it back again—a lot of steps, and it was easy to slip up.

Today, Lido is bringing direct staking back to its own UI (stake.lido.fi): on Arbitrum, Base, Linea, and Optimism, you can get wstETH in a single transaction. You first swap into wstETH through a liquidity pool on the same chain. Behind the scenes, Chainlink CCIP automatically bridges the $ETH to mainnet for staking, then replenishes the local pool with wstETH. The protocol fee remains 10% of rewards, with users receiving 90%.

This isn’t being built from scratch: Linea already offered direct staking in 2025, and a few other networks previously rolled it out in stages through partners. This time, all four are available in one place on Lido’s own interface. One side note: VanEck withdrew its application for an ETF holding stETH just the day before—that’s a separate matter.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Being flat is also a position—and it’s the one pros use most
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception among beginners: if you’re not holding a position, you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly entering and exiting,
until fees and volatility wear away their capital.

In reality, being flat is the only position with zero losses. If you can’t read the market, stay flat.
Staying flat when bulls and bears are battling, staying flat after a string of bad trades—the money you save in these moments
is more than most people make from trading.

You may be tired of the hunting metaphor, but the point is true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes just a second. If you have capital, you’ll have bullets when an opportunity comes. Hold on to your bullets.

A light node only downloads block headers. When it needs data for a particular transaction, it requests the data and a Merkle proof from a full node.

October 15 — Opening Bell Brief: U.S. Stocks and Cryptocurrency

Inflation surges well above expectations, igniting risk aversion: September PPI, released at 8:30 a.m. ET, surged 6.3% year over year, its biggest increase since late 2022, reviving rate-hike concerns. Asian markets plunged overnight: South Korea’s KOSPI briefly tumbled 8%, triggering circuit breakers, while the Nikkei 225 fell 4.8%. U.S. stocks opened with the same divergence: the Dow edged higher, the Nasdaq sank more than 1%, and Bitcoin fell below $81,000.
U.S. Stocks and Markets
In the first 10 minutes of trading (9:40 a.m. ET), the Dow rose about 0.4%, the S&P 500 $SPYB  fell about 0.3%, and the Nasdaq $QQQB 100 dropped more than 1.2%, extending the split between rising blue chips and falling tech stocks as money continued to leave the AI sector and move into defensive blue chips. Spot gold rose more than 1%, topping $4,150 an ounce, as risk aversion intensified. September PPI, released at 8:30 a.m. ET, came in far hotter than expected: up 1.3% month over month (versus 0.6% expected) and 6.3% year over year, its biggest increase since late 2022. Core PPI was also above expectations, at 5% year over year, mainly due to energy prices (gasoline surged 20.3% for the month). September retail sales, released the same day, rose 0.8% month over month, slowing from August. Following yesterday’s hotter-than-expected 3.7% CPI reading, bets on further Federal Reserve rate hikes grew. (Sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS); CME FedWatch.) Asian markets suffered a Black Thursday: South Korea’s KOSPI briefly plunged 8% intraday, triggering circuit breakers against program-driven selling, and closed down 7.7%. Samsung $SAMSUNG  fell 9%, and SK Hynix dropped 11%. The Nikkei 225 fell 4.8%, with SoftBank down 9.4%; Taiwan’s market fell 3% and Hong Kong’s Hang Seng Index dropped 1%. TSMC’s Q3 results far exceeded expectations (revenue of $46.7 billion, up 51% year over year; net income of $23.9 billion, up 69%, marking a record for the sixth consecutive quarter; and 2nm capacity remained insufficient to meet demand), but the company struck a cautious tone on 2027, failing to rescue chip stocks. CoreWeave credit default swaps (CDS) topped 1,000 basis points, and the stock fell another 4.5% premarket as concerns over AI infrastructure financing continued to mount.
Cryptocurrency
Bitcoin #BTC  fell below $81,000 overnight, briefly touching around $80,200 (near its October 8 low), before rebounding to around $81,200, down about 3% over 24 hours. ETH #ETH  fell about 6% to around $2,350; SOL and XRP were down roughly 5%, while smaller-cap tokens fared even worse. Nearly $1 billion in positions were liquidated across the market over 24 hours, with leveraged longs bearing the brunt. (Sources: CoinDesk, CoinMarketCap.) The trigger was inflation data stoking rate-hike expectations: after CPI came in hotter than expected at 3.7%, the implied probability of an October rate hike shown by CME FedWatch briefly surged to 47%.

The snapshot recorded #BTC  at $79,826, breaking through the psychological $80,000 level. The question now is: who’s selling, and can buyers absorb the pressure?

A report dated October 15, citing CoinGlass, recorded around $977 million in positions liquidated over 24 hours, of which nearly $896 million were long positions. These figures cover the entire crypto market at the time of the report—not just BTC, and not necessarily the exact moment the snapshot was taken.

Why can prices fall so fast?

Hotter-than-expected US core CPI has investors worried that the Fed may tighten policy further. That’s a headwind for risk assets. As prices keep falling, under-margined long positions are forcibly closed, adding more pressure and potentially triggering another wave of liquidations.

Put simply: you were waiting for a bounce to get out, but the exchange closed your position first.

What I’m watching after this drop:

• Can BTC reclaim and hold $80,000?
• Is open interest falling alongside the liquidations?
• Is spot buying absorbing the selling, or is the price only bouncing because short sellers are closing their positions?

#ETH  and altcoins also need to be watched separately. A BTC recovery doesn’t mean the whole portfolio will recover at the same pace, especially coins with thin liquidity.

And don’t jump to the conclusion that “the shakeout is over, and we’re ready to take off.”

Heavy liquidations show that many leveraged positions have been cleared out of the market. They don’t prove that sellers are exhausted or that buyers are strong enough to form a bottom.

$80,000 is an easy-to-remember round number. Whether the market can hold it depends on the flow of funds after this break below the level.

Blob has its own fee market: the blob base fee automatically adjusts based on the difference between usage and the target, and is also burned.
Blob is cheap because blob data is stored for only about 18 days, rather than permanently, and isn't processed by the EVM, putting far less strain on nodes.

BitMine discloses holdings of 6.029 million ETH | Accumulation happened last week, not a buy order tonight | I’ll wait for confirmation around 2357

My stance is cautious and defensive: the fact that companies are allocating to ETH for the long term is worth tracking, but a disclosed weekly holdings figure cannot stand in for market demand right now. On October 13, BitMine filed an 8-K and exhibits with the U.S. SEC, disclosing that as of 1:30 p.m. Eastern Time on October 11, it held 6,028,946 ETH, or about 4.9% of the circulating supply it cited. Management said it purchased 12,532 ETH the previous week. The filing also listed 5,067,309 ETH as staked, about 84% of its holdings. These figures reflect the company’s holdings at a stated point in time; they are not buy orders placed just now on the evening of October 15, and they do not justify inferring net outflows from exchanges tonight or that prices must rise.

I’m paying particular attention to the caveats in the latter part of the announcement: the company calls getting close to 5% of total supply a strategic goal, but a goal is not the same as having achieved it. Both the annualized income estimated from the current amount staked and the higher income projected if everything were staked are based on short-term yield estimates; the filing itself cautions that future returns may differ. Staking locks up part of the circulating supply and may affect the amount of ETH available to trade, but that does not mean spot demand will keep increasing. If the company slows its purchases in the future or adjusts its position for financing or operational needs, the supply narrative could also shift in the opposite direction. Ethereum’s fundamentals also depend on actual on-chain usage, fees, L2 activity flowing back to Ethereum, and development progress—not just one company’s treasury ambitions.

The market has already sent a measured signal. At the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $2,357, with a 24-hour range of about $2,313–$2,451, still below today’s open of around $2,419. This is just a market snapshot; I’m not attributing the decline solely to BitMine’s announcement. Farside shows combined net outflows of about $129.5 million from U.S. spot ETH funds on October 14, a separate data point from a different time and measured on a different basis. October 15 has not yet been fully reported, and a dash absolutely does not mean zero. Corporate holdings and single-day fund redemptions are moving in opposite directions, showing that a long-term narrative and short-term liquidity pressures can coexist.

The key levels I’m watching are $2,313, $2,400, and $2,451. $2,313 is the rolling low for this move; losing it would increase the risk of trying to catch a falling knife. $2,400 is the round-number level ETH needs to reclaim, while $2,451 is the 24-hour high; only a break above that would make a continuation worth discussing. I would reverse my current defensive view and reassess based on new facts if the company later amends its SEC filing, fund outflows widen, and ETH breaks below $2,313 again—or, conversely, if ETH holds above $2,451 on strong volume and fund inflows return.

If I were trading this myself: I would stay out for now, with the only direction under consideration being an unleveraged spot long, and position size at 0%. 我的态度是谨慎偏防守：企业长期配置ETH的事实值得跟踪，但不能拿一份已披露的周度持仓，替代此刻的市场需求。BitMine于10月13日向美国SEC提交8-K及附件，披露截至10月11日美东时间13:30持有6,028,946枚ETH，约占其引用的ETH流通量4.9%；管理层称前一周购入12,532枚。文件还列出其中5,067,309枚已质押，约占持仓84%。这些是公司给定时点的披露，不是10月15日晚间刚发生的买单，更不能由此推断今晚交易所净流出或价格必涨。

我特别留意公告后半段的边界：公司把接近总供应量5%称作战略目标，但目标尚未等于完成；按当前质押规模估算的年化收入，以及全部质押后的更高收入，均采用短期收益率推算，文件自己也提示未来收益可能不同。质押锁定部分流通供给，可能影响可交易筹码，却并不等于现货需求会持续增加。若企业未来放慢买入、为融资或运营而调整仓位，供给叙事也会反向变化。以太坊基本面还要看链上真实使用、手续费、L2回流与开发进度，不能只看一家公司的财库口号。

市场已经给出一个克制的信号。写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约2357美元，24小时区间约2313—2451美元，仍低于今日开盘约2419美元；这只是行情快照，不把跌势单因果归给BitMine公告。Farside显示美国ETH现货基金10月14日合计净流出约1.295亿美元，属于另一个时间和统计口径；10月15日尚未完整填报，横杠绝不能当零。企业持仓与基金单日赎回方向相反，说明中长期叙事和短期流动性可以同时存在。

关键位我看2313、2400及2451美元。2313是本轮滚动低点，失守意味着接刀风险升高；2400是需要重新夺回的整数关口，2451是近24小时高点，突破后才谈延续。如果后续公司SEC文件修正持仓、基金流出扩大且ETH再破2313，或者反过来ETH带量站稳2451并有基金资金回流，我会推翻现在的防守判断，按新事实重估。

如果是我自己交易：目前不参与，方向暂定只观察无杠杆现货多单，仓位0%。只有1小时收盘站上2400、回踩2390—2400不破，且下一小时没有迅速跌回，才考虑动用总资金最多0.5%试多；到2435先减半，2450—2455把余仓平掉，不把目标写成必达。若入场后1小时收回2390下先减半，跌破2370全部止损；未触发前先破2313则取消计划。宁可错过反弹，也不因为企业持仓数字漂亮就追单。

Whoa, is an exchange buying a bank outright now? 🏦

Payward, Kraken’s parent company, just signed an acquisition agreement to buy Finnish holding company Saldo Finance Oy and its subsidiary Saldo Bank, which holds a Lithuanian banking license.

A few key points 👇
🔹 Saldo Bank has around €164 million in assets (about $190 million); the purchase price hasn’t been disclosed
🔹 Its banking license can open doors to multiple European markets
🔹 The deal is expected to close in 2027, pending regulatory approval. For now, it’s signed but not completed

What’s the plan? Pretty straightforward: interest-bearing deposits, issuing cards, and borrowing against crypto assets—so you can get cash without selling your coins.

Until now, exchanges have relied on partner banks for deposits, withdrawals, and payments. Owning a bank means keeping deposits, payments, lending, and crypto all under one roof.

Exchanges aren’t just competing to list coins anymore—they’re after your entire wallet. Would you deposit fiat in a bank run by an exchange? 👀

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Matters More Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% of their time reviewing their own trades. They’ve got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (the rationale), what went right or wrong (execution),
and what you’ll do differently next time (a specific action). Stick with it for a month, and you’ll be shocked to discover that your losses
Your trade log is full of the same mistakes repeating—for example, immediately reversing your position after getting stopped out,
or never holding on to winning trades.

The market changes, but your behavior patterns won’t change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don’t just look at your account balance—review your trading records.

Ethereum Market Deep-Dive: Under Pressure and Recovery Amid Macroeconomic Headwinds

I. Price Action Review

At 2,346 USD as of October 15, 2026, Beijing time, Ethereum has fallen approximately 4.2% over the past 24 hours, a notably larger drop than Bitcoin’s. The price has steadily declined from yesterday’s high of around 2,375 USD, reaching a low of 2,324 USD before finding support near 2,337 USD and making a modest rebound. On the hourly chart, after four consecutive hours of losses, the latest candle closed as a small bullish candle with a relatively long lower wick. This suggests some buying support at lower levels, although the overall rebound remains limited. Compared with Bitcoin, Ethereum has shown greater weakness during this pullback, reflecting the market’s cautious stance toward its near-term outlook.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

In terms of moving averages, the current price has fallen below the 7-day moving average at 2,362 USD, the 25-day moving average at 2,394 USD, and the 99-day moving average at 2,486 USD. The bearish alignment is firmly in place, and the gaps between the averages are still widening. The 7-day moving average is sloping sharply downward, creating clear short-term pressure. Notably, the price is now more than 140 USD below the 99-day moving average, indicating that the medium-term trend remains weak.

The Bollinger Bands show the price trading near the lower band at 2,327 USD, with the middle band at 2,384 USD and the upper band at 2,441 USD. The bands are widening to the downside, indicating rising volatility and a bearish bias. The price is hugging the lower band. Although a technical rebound is possible, during a strong downtrend the price may continue to track the lower band toward still lower support levels.

For MACD, the DIFF line is at -27.93, the DEA line at -28.56, and the histogram at 0.63. Although the histogram has just turned positive, its absolute value is extremely small, and the bearish trend has yet to undergo a meaningful reversal. The 6-period RSI has rebounded from a low of 24.51 to 44.48, indicating that a short-term recovery from oversold conditions is underway, though it has not yet entered neutral territory. On the KDJ indicator, K at 44.77 has crossed above D at 42.18, forming a low-level golden cross, while J is at 49.96—signals of potential short-term rebound momentum.

The 14-period ATR is 24.78 and remains relatively high, indicating that market volatility is still intense. The Parabolic SAR is at 2,324 USD, slightly below the current price. This has temporarily shifted to a bullish signal, but further confirmation from price action is needed.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

Ethereum’s latest decline has been driven by several overlapping negative factors. First, inflationary pressure at the macroeconomic level: a higher-than-expected U.S. September CPI reading fueled rate-hike concerns, directly weighing on risk assets, including Ethereum. Second, persistent outflows: Ethereum spot ETFs have recently recorded average daily net outflows of approximately 129.5 million USD. Combined outflows from BTC and SOL ETFs were nearly 400 million USD, and the large-scale withdrawal of institutional capital has put heavy pressure on prices.

There has also been unfavorable regulatory news. VanEck withdrew its application for a Lido staked Ethereum ETF, dealing a blow to the recent institutional staking narrative and weakening expectations that Ethereum staking products will be approved. On-chain data shows net outflows of more than 400 million USD over the past 24 hours, alongside a marked increase in large sell orders, suggesting that major holders are reducing positions or hedging risk.

Overall indicators show that bearish factors account for as much as 73.3%, while bullish factors make up just 26.7%, reflecting distinctly pessimistic market sentiment. The composite indicator is signaling bearishness, with a historical win rate of 90.48%, suggesting relatively high reliability. In the short term, Ethereum needs to hold the key support level at 2,320 USD. A break below it could lead to a further decline toward 2,300 USD or even lower. 以太坊市场深度分析：宏观逆风下的承压与修复

一、价格走势回顾

北京时间二零二六年十月十五日，以太坊报价二千三百四十六美元，过去二十四小时累计下跌约百分之四点二，跌幅明显大于比特币。价格从昨日高点二千三百七十五美元附近持续走低，最低下探至二千三百二十四美元，随后在二千三百三十七美元附近获得支撑并出现小幅反弹。从小时K线来看，以太坊经历了连续四个交易小时的下跌后，最新一根K线收出带较长下影线的小阳线，显示低位有一定买盘承接，但整体反弹力度有限。与比特币相比，以太坊在本轮调整中表现出更强的弱势特征，反映出市场对其短期前景的谨慎态度。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，当前价格已全面跌破七日均线二千三百六十二美元、二十五日均线二千三百九十四美元和九十九日均线二千四百八十六美元，空头排列形态完整且差距仍在扩大。七日均线下行斜率较陡，短线压力明显。值得注意的是，价格与九十九日均线之间的差距已超过一百四十美元，表明中期趋势依然偏弱。

布林带指标显示，价格运行在下轨二千三百二十七美元附近，中轨位于二千三百八十四美元，上轨在二千四百四十一美元。布林带开口向下扩大，意味着波动率上升且方向偏空。价格紧贴下轨运行，虽然存在技术性反弹的可能，但在强势下跌行情中，价格可能沿下轨持续走低至更低的支撑区域。

MACD方面，DIFF线为负二十七点九三，DEA线为负二十八点五六，柱状图为零点六三，虽然柱状图刚刚翻红，但绝对值极小，空头趋势尚未出现实质性扭转。RSI六周期从最低二十四点五一回升至四十四点四八，短线超卖修复进行中，但尚未进入中性区域。KDJ指标中K值四十四点七七上穿D值四十二点一八，形成低位金叉信号，J值四十九点九六，提示短期存在反弹动能。

ATR十四周期为二十四点七八，维持在相对高位，说明市场波动仍然剧烈。抛物线SAR位于二千三百二十四美元，略低于当前价格，暂时转为看多信号，但需要价格进一步确认。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊本轮下跌受到多重利空因素叠加影响。首先是宏观层面的通胀压力，美国九月CPI超预期走高引发加息担忧，直接打压了包括以太坊在内的风险资产。其次是资金面的持续流出，以太坊现货ETF在近期录得约一点二九五亿美元的日均净流出，叠加BTC和SOL ETF合计流出近四亿美元，机构资金的大规模撤离对价格形成了沉重压力。

此外，监管层面也传来不利消息。VanEck撤回了其Lido质押以太坊ETF的申请，这对近期机构质押叙事造成了打击，削弱了市场对以太坊质押产品获批的预期。在链上数据方面，过去二十四小时内净流出资金超过四亿美元，大单卖出明显增多，显示大户正在减仓或对冲风险。

从综合指标来看，空头因子占比高达百分之七十三点三，多头因子仅占百分之二十六点七，市场情绪明显偏向悲观。复合指标发出看空信号，历史胜率为百分之九十点四八，可靠性较高。短期内以太坊需要守住二千三百二十美元的关键支撑位，若失守则可能进一步下探二千三百美元甚至更低。不过，KDJ低位金叉和RSI超卖修复为短线反弹提供了一定技术基础，投资者可关注二千三百八十美元阻力位的突破情况。

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | Five Rules I Keep Beside My Screen—Sharing Them Just as They Are
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotionally charged days, people forget every lesson, so I wrote these down and stuck them up where I can see them:

One: Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t write it down, don’t enter.
Two: Never let a single trade lose more than 2% of your capital. No exceptions.
Three: Don’t add to losing positions. Never average down.
Four: After three losing trades in a row, stop for the day. Just watch—don’t trade.
Five: Withdraw some of your profits. The money you take out is cash; what you leave behind is peace of mind.

That’s all five rules. Not one is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money has never
been that they misread the market—it’s that their execution fell apart. Let’s keep each other accountable.

title: The Fed’s New Playbook, Hot Inflation and Mastercard’s Crypto Push: What It Means for Bitcoin and Et
subTitle:
Global markets are facing three important forces: a changing Federal Reserve communication strategy, rising U.S. producer inflation, and the expansion of crypto-related payment infrastructure. Each affects markets differently, but together they create a complicated environment for investors.
The key question is whether tighter financial conditions will outweigh the long-term benefits of crypto adoption.
1. Why the Fed’s Communication Strategy Matters
Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh has advocated reducing reliance on forward guidance and the dot plot. Forward guidance communicates policymakers’ views on the likely direction of monetary policy, while the dot plot presents individual Federal Open Market Committee participants’ interest-rate projections.
Neither tool guarantees future policy decisions. Economic conditions can change, forcing policymakers to adjust their outlook.
The historical context matters. After the 2008 financial crisis, central banks increasingly used communication to influence market expectations, especially when conventional interest-rate cuts became less effective. The Fed introduced its dot plot in 2012.
Reducing forward guidance could give policymakers more flexibility, but it may also leave investors with fewer clues about future rate decisions.
For financial markets, the result could be greater sensitivity to inflation reports, employment data and Treasury yields. If investors cannot confidently anticipate the Fed’s next move, sudden repricing becomes more likely.
For Bitcoin and Ethereum, this matters because both assets can respond sharply to changes in liquidity expectations and investor risk appetite.
2. Hot U.S. Inflation Could Complicate the Fed’s Decisions
The reported September 2026 U.S. Producer Price Index showed annual inflation of 6.3%, while monthly producer prices increased 1.3%.
Producer inflation measures price changes received by domestic producers. It does not directly measure the cost of living, but persistent increases can signal rising costs for businesses.
The geopolitical connection is important.
Conflicts, sanctions and disruptions to energy shipments can increase oil prices, transport expenses and insurance costs. Businesses may eventually pass some of these expenses to consumers.
If inflation remains elevated, the Fed may have less room to cut interest rates. Higher rates can make bonds and cash more attractive relative to riskier assets.
This creates a potential challenge for crypto markets.
Bitcoin is sometimes described as an inflation hedge because its supply is limited. However, its short-term behavior has often reflected liquidity conditions and investor risk appetite rather than inflation alone.
If inflation rises alongside higher Treasury yields and a stronger dollar, Bitcoin and Ethereum could face selling pressure. If inflation cools and financial conditions ease, the same assets may benefit from renewed risk-taking.
The critical variable is how inflation changes expectations for monetary policy.
3. Geopolitics, the Dollar and Institutional Capital Flows
The U.S. dollar remains central to global trade, commodity markets and international borrowing. Consequently, changes in U.S. monetary policy can influence capital flows well beyond American markets.
When Treasury yields rise, global investors may shift money toward dollar-denominated assets. Companies and governments with dollar debt can also face higher financing costs.
Geopolitical tensions can intensify these movements by disrupting energy supplies, trade routes and financial relationships.
For crypto investors, the transmission mechanism is relatively straightforward:
Geopolitical tensions can raise energy costs. Higher costs can sustain inflation. Persistent inflation can delay rate cuts. Higher yields and a stronger dollar can tighten financial conditions. Tighter conditions can reduce speculative demand for crypto.
However, the opposite mechanism can operate over a longer period. Concerns about currency instability, capital restrictions or dependence on traditional financial intermediaries may encourage interest in alternative payment and settlement systems.
These outcomes are not contradictory. Short-term liquidity pressures can hurt crypto prices even while long-term demand for blockchain infrastructure increases.
4. Mastercard’s Crypto Expansion: Adoption Does Not Guarantee Higher Prices
Mastercard’s expansion into stablecoin infrastructure highlights the growing connection between traditional finance and blockchain-based payments.
Its Global Money Platform, developed with BVNK, is designed to support services such as multi-currency accounts, stablecoin-linked cards, conversion and payouts.
This is important because established payment networks can help make digital-asset transactions more accessible to businesses and consumers.
However, payment-network reach should not be confused with the number of active crypto users. A large global network does not mean every customer can immediately access every crypto service.
The investment implications depend on actual usage.
First, payment integrations can reduce friction for cross-border transfers and business payments.
Second, stablecoins may become more useful for settlement and remittances.
Third, infrastructure providers may generate revenue from conversion, payment processing and related services.
But greater stablecoin usage does not automatically create demand for Bitcoin or Ethereum. A transaction can use a dollar-pegged stablecoin without requiring the user to purchase BTC.
Ethereum may benefit if increased payment activity translates into meaningful network usage and economic value for ETH. The same principle applies to other blockchain networks.
Investors should therefore distinguish between a promising partnership and measurable economic demand.
5. What Could Happen to $BTC  and ETH?
The interaction between monetary policy and crypto adoption creates several possible outcomes.
Scenario One: Inflation remains elevated.
If producer inflation continues to pressure the Fed, markets may price in higher interest rates for longer. Rising yields and dollar strength could weigh on Bitcoin and Ethereum, particularly if leveraged positions begin to unwind.
Scenario Two: Inflation cools.
If price pressures ease and the Fed becomes more comfortable with monetary easing, liquidity expectations could improve. This may support risk assets, although market positioning and economic growth will still matter.
Scenario Three: Crypto adoption expands without stronger token demand.
Mastercard-related payment activity could increase while Bitcoin and Ethereum prices remain under pressure. Infrastructure growth and token valuations do not always move together.
Scenario Four: Adoption expands as financial conditions improve.
This combination could offer a more supportive environment for crypto. Better liquidity may encourage investment, while real payment activity could strengthen the long-term case for selected blockchain networks.
None of these scenarios is guaranteed. Investors must assess incoming data rather than assume that one headline determines the market’s direction.
6. A Practical Framework for Investors
For short-term traders, inflation data, Treasury yields, dollar movements and the market’s reaction to Federal Reserve statements deserve close attention.
A hot inflation report does not automatically justify a short position. If the market has already priced in the news, prices may recover. Likewise, a dovish policy signal does not guarantee a rally if investors are worried about economic weakness.
Avoid excessive leverage during major economic releases. Sudden price movements can trigger liquidations even when the broader investment thesis remains valid.
For longer-term investors, the focus should be different.
Bitcoin investors should evaluate liquidity conditions, institutional demand, market structure and portfolio risk.
Ethereum investors should monitor network activity, transaction economics and whether increased adoption creates sustainable demand for $ETH.
Investors in Bangladesh should also consider BDT/$USDC  exchange-rate movements, transaction costs and applicable local regulations. Dollar-denominated gains do not always translate into equivalent returns in taka.
7. What Investors Should Watch Next
Three developments deserve attention.
First, the Federal Reserve’s upcoming policy decisions will help clarify how policymakers respond to persistent inflation and whether reduced forward guidance changes market expectations.
Second, upcoming inflation and employment reports will indicate whether price pressure is spreading through the economy or beginning to ease.
Third, Mastercard’s real payment volumes, stablecoin activity and the economics of supported blockchain networks will provide better evidence of adoption than headline announcements alone.
The distinction between confirmed developments and expectations is essential. A proposal is not an implemented policy. A partnership is not proof of mass adoption. A bullish narrative is not a trading signal.
Final Takeaway
The Fed’s changing communication strategy could make markets more sensitive to economic data, particularly while inflation remains elevated. That creates near-term uncertainty for Bitcoin and Ethereum if higher yields and a stronger dollar tighten financial conditions.
Mastercard’s crypto expansion presents a different opportunity: the gradual integration of blockchain-based payments into established financial infrastructure. Its long-term significance will depend on actual adoption, transaction volumes and the value captured by individual networks and assets.
The practical approach is to separate the macroeconomic trade from the long-term adoption thesis. Monitor inflation, Treasury yields and dollar liquidity for short-term decisions. Track real network usage and token economics for long-term investment analysis.
Do not confuse institutional adoption with guaranteed price appreciation. Manage risk, avoid emotional trading and make decisions based on evidence rather than headlines.

translatedData.content:
Tonight at 8:30 p.m. (Beijing time, October 15, 20:30), two high-impact U.S. data releases land at once: September retail sales and September PPI. The takeaway first: consumer resilience exceeded expectations, while inflation at the producer level accelerated again—reinforcing the narrative that the Fed will continue tightening.

Retail sales: September rose 0.8% month over month, versus expectations of 0.3%. The previous reading was revised up from 1.1% to 1.3%. Excluding autos, sales rose 0.9%, bringing total sales to $745 billion. Consumers haven’t let up—in fact, spending was stronger than expected.

PPI: September final-demand PPI rose 1.3% month over month, the largest monthly increase since March 2022. It was up 6.3% year over year, versus expectations of 5.3%. By category, goods rose 2.6% and services 0.8%. Price increases are no longer confined to energy; they’re spreading down the supply chain.

Taken together, the message is clear: demand (retail sales) remains strong, while prices on the supply side (PPI) are rising. PPI is a leading indicator of CPI, and rising producer prices often pass through to consumer prices several months later. The FOMC meets on October 27–28, and this combination of “strong demand + hot inflation” will push up market expectations for “further tightening and higher rates for longer.”

The transmission chain is straightforward: rising expectations for tighter policy → stronger U.S. Treasury yields and the dollar → tighter global dollar liquidity → pressure on risk-asset valuations. $BTC  is a non-yielding asset with one of the highest betas, making it especially sensitive to changes in dollar liquidity—and putting it under the most direct pressure. Conversely, if upcoming data cool and expectations for tightening ease, the chain runs in reverse, creating a tailwind for $BTC  and $ETH .

Remember: crypto responds to how expectations for “tighter or looser dollar liquidity” are revised, not whether the numbers themselves are high or low. Tonight’s two releases point in one direction—expectations for tighter policy are rising.

#BTC #ETH #Crypto

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Getting Rich Slowly: What Compounding Really Looks Like in Crypto
translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly hold on to their gains in this market are the ones who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day over 250 trading days a year adds up to 12x; a steady 10% a month
adds up to 30x over three years. It may not sound thrilling, but it has one remarkable quality—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. You wait for the market, but discipline is up to you. Don’t set your goal

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Does the Candle You FOMO Into Usually Look Like?
translatedData.subTitle:
The coin price shoots up in a big bullish candle, everyone in the group is shouting “Buy!”, and you impulsively chase in—only to end up buying at
the very top. This scenario plays out every day.

Look closely at that big bullish candle that gets your heart racing: it’s what people who are already fully invested hope you’ll chase in to take
their position. Chasing after a high-volume surge is essentially providing liquidity to those who got in earlier.

A simple but effective trick: when you feel like chasing, force yourself to wait for three candlesticks. If the pullback comes on declining volume and then stabilizes,
you’ll get a better entry. If it falls straight back down, congratulations—you’ve saved yourself an expensive lesson. The market will always
give you a second chance, but it won’t give you your principal back a second time.

When a Layer 2 network writes blob data to the mainnet, the blob fee is also settled in $ETH .
Understand the principles before taking action. Don’t place an order on impulse.

Don't rush or aim too big. If you only have a few hundred U as your starting capital, honestly, it's better to stick to the trend.
#ETH 
With just a few hundred U, jumping into high-leverage futures, chasing whichever coin suddenly spikes, and then adding to your position to average down after a loss is a bad idea.

You might get lucky and make a few profits at first. But when a big market move finally goes against you, you'll give back everything you made—and could even lose your entire principal.

So when you're starting with a small amount of capital, the most important thing isn't proving how skilled you are. It's learning from people with experience.

By “following the pros,” I don't mean blindly copying their trades, let alone handing your money over for someone else to manage. I mean learning why they chose a particular entry point, how they manage position sizes, why they set stop-losses, and why they're willing to stay out of the market and wait.

You'll notice that people who have been successful for a long time actually make fewer trades. They don't rush in just because a coin is up 20%, and they don't panic and sell just because it's down a few percent.

Wait when there's no opportunity, and only act when the conditions are right. With just a few hundred U, you don't have much room for error, and you certainly can't afford to make one mistake after another.

Instead of researching dozens of altcoins every day, focus on a few major coins. Instead of constantly dreaming of doubling your money, learn how much you can afford to lose on a trade before you have to stop. Instead of searching everywhere for some so-called get-rich-quick formula, take the time to truly understand one simple strategy.

A small amount of capital doesn't mean you have no opportunities—it means you need even more patience.
#币圈暴富

subTitle:
بين نزيف المحافظ وحلم الـ 180 ألف دولار: هل يختبر السوق صبرنا قبل الانفجار الكبير؟ 📉🚀  
​يعيش سوق الكريبتو اليوم حالة من الانفصام العجيب التي تلخصها تماماً المنشورات الرائجة حالياً؛ فمن جهة نرى متداولين يصرخون من الألم، ومن جهة أخرى محللين يبشرون بقمم تاريخية غير مسبوقة! فكيف نفسر هذا التناقض؟  
​الوجه الأول: وجع اللحظة وضغط التصحيحات 😤
على المدى القصير، الصورة قاتمة ومؤلمة للكثيرين، خاصة لمن يتداولون بالرافعة المالية (Futures). نرى اليوم محافظ تعاني من تراجعات حادة في أسعار الإيثيريوم ($ETH ) والبيتكوين ($BTC )، وصفقات شراء مفتوحة منذ أسابيع تغرق في الخسائر غير المحققة وتستنزف الأعصاب في انتظار "ارتداد" طال انتظاره. السؤال الذي يتردد على لسان الجميع الآن في لحظات الهبوط هذه: "من الذي يبيع عند هذه المستويات بحق الجحيم؟ وهل نصبر أم نخرج؟"  
​الوجه الثاني: النظرة الكبرى وإشارات الماكرو 🔭
إذا ابتعدنا قليلاً عن ضجيج الشاشات اللحظي ونظرنا إلى الصورة الأكبر (الإطار الشهري)، نجد قصة مختلفة تماماً. الحديث يدور اليوم حول أهداف سعرية للبيتكوين تتراوح بين 160,000$ و 180,000$. لكن السر الحقيقي لا يكمن في هذه الأرقام المتفائلة بحد ذاتها، بل في مؤشر الـ MACD الشهري.
مؤشر الزخم بدأ يظهر بوادر انحناء صعودي بعد فترة طويلة من البقاء تحت خط الصفر والانضغاط. وإذا تحولت هذه الحركة الناشئة إلى تقاطع صعودي مؤكد، فنحن أمام تحول جذري في زخم البيتكوين على المدى الطويل.  
​الخلاصة: كيف تنجو بين المطرقة والسندان؟ 💡
الدرس الأهم من دمج هذين المشهدين هو أن الإشارات المبكرة على الفريمات الكبيرة لا تعني أبداً أن الصعود سيكون بخط مستقيم أو مضموناً غداً. السوق ماهر جداً في إخراج المتداولين المستعجلين (أصحاب الرافعة المالية العالية) عبر هبوط يثير الضيق والملل، وذلك تماماً قبل أن تكتمل إشارات الانطلاق الكبرى.  
​إذا كنت متداول عقود آجلة: انتبه جيداً لسعر التصفية (Liquidation Price)، فالتفاؤل بأهداف الـ 180 ألف دولار لن ينفعك إذا تم تصفية محفظتك في تصحيح عابر اليوم.  
​إذا كنت مستثمراً على المدى الطويل: لا تدع الشموع الحمراء اليومية تُنسيك مراقبة مؤشرات الزخم الشهرية، فالموجات الكبرى تولد دائماً من رحم الإحباط.

Claim that ETH accounts for 60% of liquidations trends｜Don’t quietly swap the denominator for the entire market｜I’m waiting for a reclaim of 2,400

My stance is to stay defensive first, and not automatically interpret high liquidation figures as meaning “the shorts are all out.” A topic claiming “Ethereum accounts for 60% of crypto market liquidations” appeared on Binance Square’s trending list. Checking the CoinGlass snapshot cited by Binance News at the time, the article put the notional value of ETH contract liquidations at about $286 million and BTC at about $197 million. Dividing $286 million by their combined total gives roughly 59%, so “about 60%” can describe ETH’s share of these two major assets. But the report also lists liquidations in other assets, including SOL and ZEC, so you can’t quietly change the denominator from those two coins to “the entire crypto market.” Different outlets also took their snapshots at different times, and the figures change continuously. What concerns me more is whether this framing might lead traders to mistakenly believe the risk has already been flushed out.

Notional liquidation value is not the same as the cash traders actually lost, nor does it mean ETH has been permanently destroyed on-chain. When highly leveraged positions fall short of their margin requirements, they are forcibly liquidated. Market orders can hit an already thin order book, potentially amplifying the interaction between falling prices and stop-losses. But the end of this mechanical selling pressure does not guarantee that fresh spot demand will immediately step in. The official U.S. September CPI figure of 3.7% year over year remains part of the macro backdrop. On October 14, U.S. spot ETH funds recorded net outflows of about $129.5 million in total, according to Farside’s fund-by-fund table. That figure reflects flows from the previous trading day and cannot be used directly to explain liquidation figures from a particular hour today.

The market itself has yet to confirm a recovery. At the time of writing, the latest Kraken ETH/USD trade was around $2,351.50, with a 24-hour open of about $2,418.61, a high of $2,492.98, and a low of $2,313.42—still below $2,400. Last time, I only said I wouldn’t try to catch a falling knife before $2,400 was reclaimed; I did not claim to have made a trade or earned a profit. Nor am I repackaging the same break below that level as fresh good news just because it is trending again. If prices keep seesawing at low levels, I’d rather miss the first bounce than chase an unverified percentage based on inconsistent data during a period of high volatility using leveraged contracts.

If I were trading with my own money, I would stay out for now, with no directional position and 0% exposure. Only if ETH gets back above $2,400, holds on a pullback for at least an hour, and BTC stops showing clear weakness would I use at most 4% of my total capital to cautiously go long spot. I’d take half off at the first target of $2,470, then gradually close the rest near the second target of $2,500. If the price falls back below $2,350 after entry, I’d stop out and close the entire position. If it breaks below $2,310 first, the original long plan is off; I would neither add to the position during a sharp drop nor bet on catching the bottom with high leverage. The conditions that would overturn my current cautious view are a sustained reclaim of $2,400, accompanied by contracting volatility and verifiable spot demand—not merely a liquidation chart.

#EtherTook60%OfCryptoLiquidations #ETH
The above is solely my personal market commentary and does not constitute investment advice.

我的态度是先防守，不把高额爆仓自动解读为“空头已经卖完”。币安广场热榜出现“以太坊拿走六成加密市场爆仓”的话题。核对币安新闻所引的CoinGlass当时快照，文中给出ETH约2.86亿美元、BTC约1.97亿美元的合约强平名义金额。2.86除以两者之和约59%，所以“约六成”可以描述ETH在这两大资产中的占比；但报道同时列出SOL、ZEC等其他资产强平，便不能把两币分母悄悄换成“整个加密市场”。不同媒体抓取时间也不同，金额会滚动变化。我更关心的是这种表述是否让交易者误判风险已经出清。

强平名义金额并不等于交易者实际亏掉的现金，更不等于链上ETH被永久销毁。高杠杆仓位在保证金不足时被强制平仓，市价单冲击原本偏薄的订单簿，可能使下跌与追加止损相互放大；但这种机械卖压告一段落，并不保证新的现货需求立刻接力。美国九月CPI同比3.7%的官方数据仍是宏观背景，10月14日美国ETH现货基金在Farside逐只表上合计净流出约1.295亿美元，属于上一个交易日的申赎统计，不可直接拿来解释今天某一小时的强平数字。

市场自身尚未确认修复。写稿时Kraken ETH/USD最近成交约2351.50美元，24小时开盘约2418.61、高2492.98、低2313.42，仍在2400下方。上轮我只说未收复2400不接飞刀，并没有声称执行过交易或获得收益；现在也没有因热榜重新把同一跌破事件包装成新利好。若报价继续在低位来回拉锯，我宁愿错过第一段反抽，也不在高波动时用合约杠杆追逐一个未经统一口径验证的百分比。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向空仓，仓位0%。只有ETH重新站上2400美元、至少一小时回踩不破，且BTC不再明显转弱，才用总资金最多4%做现货试多；第一目标2470先减半，第二目标2500附近逐步平仓。入场后若跌回2350以下就止损并全部平仓；若先下破2310，原多头计划作废，不在急跌中加仓，也不高杠杆赌抄底。推翻当前谨慎判断的条件是价格持续收复2400，并伴随波动收敛和可验证的现货承接，而不是只看到一张爆仓统计图。

title: ⚡ $ETH Di Bawah $2200: Liquidasi Long, Rebound Kuat, & Lonjakan Staking! 📈
subTitle:
Pasar Ethereum ($ETH) mengalami volatilitas tinggi setelah harganya sempat merosot drastis hingga di bawah $2200. Penurunan tajam ini dengan cepat memicu long liquidations besar-besaran di pasar futures. 
Namun, $ETH segera menunjukkan pemulihan (rebound) yang kuat didukung oleh lonjakan volume perdagangan yang sangat tinggi di Binance. 
📊 Highlight & Sentimen Pasar Derivatif
Pasar Options (Deribit):
Terjadi negative outlier pada delta skew, mengindikasikan dominasi put options dibandingkan call options. Ini mencerminkan sentimen bearish jangka pendek di mana para trader melakukan hedging terhadap risiko penurunan lebih lanjut. 
Implied Volatility meningkat, menandakan ekspektasi fluktuasi harga yang tinggi dalam waktu dekat. 
Pasar Perpetual Futures (Deribit):
Funding rate untuk ETH-Perpetual menunjukkan lonjakan positif (positive outlier). Holder posisi long membayar premium tinggi kepada posisi short, yang menandakan sentimen bullish yang kuat saat trader membuka posisi long baru selama fase pemulihan harga. 
Open Interest & Deleveraging (OKX):
Open Interest pada ETH-USDT-SWAP di OKX mengalami penurunan drastis karena banyaknya penutupan/likuidasi posisi long saat harga anjlok. 
🏛️ Fondasi Jangka Panjang: TVL & Staking Surge
Meskipun terjadi volatilitas jangka pendek, indikator fundamental dan jangka panjang $ETH tetap menunjukkan keyakinan yang sangat kuat:
Penguatan TVL Layer 1: Total Value Locked (TVL) di Layer 1 Ethereum tetap mendominasi ruang DeFi dengan angka bernilai miliaran dolar. 
Spike Staking ETH di Binance: Protocol staked ETH di Binance mencatatkan lonjakan TVL yang signifikan. Banyak investor memanfaatkan dip (penurunan harga) sebagai kesempatan untuk menambah staking ETH mereka. 
Pengembangan Jaringan: Diskusi pengembang ETH mengenai rencana upgrade 'Hegota' menunjukkan komitmen keberlanjutan jaringan jangka panjang. 
💡 Kesimpulan Bagi Trader & Investor
Fluktuasi harga ini mencerminkan dinamika pembersihan leverage (deleveraging) di pasar derivatif. Namun, respon akumulasi cepat melalui perpetual futures serta lonjakan staking menunjukkan bahwa keyakinan pasar terhadap prospek jangka panjang $ETH tetap sangat solid.

A three-leg hedge may look stable, but it really just shifts the risk elsewhere. If ETH and HYPE keep moving in one direction, margin will be eaten up faster and faster.

The top three gainers today: gold tokens, stablecoins, and stablecoins. This picture is more interesting than the market itself being down 3 points—the money hasn’t left; it’s still in the market, just playing dead.

Here’s what I did: when $ETH 2,400 was sliding, I trimmed some of my position first and held onto the rest. This morning, I saw that ETH open interest was up 18.13% over one hour, while the long/short ratio was still at 3.15. Honestly, that made me nervous—prices were falling, but longs were still piling in. I’ve seen how that kind of setup played out before, and it wasn’t pretty. I’m not sure if this time will be the same.

$BTC 81,006—I personally think this level can hold for now, but only 5 of the 30 coins are in the green. With breadth like that, it’s not just about any one coin. What concerns me more is that the Fear and Greed Index is still at 53; sentiment hasn’t really shifted yet. My rule of thumb: when sentiment hasn’t shifted, I don’t rush to buy the dip. I’d rather miss out on some gains.

For now, I’m just watching that 4.21B in trading volume at $USDC . Maybe the funds will only truly flow back in once that volume starts to shrink. Are you holding on and playing dead, or have you already gotten out?

title: 交易心理 | 扛单的时候，你的大脑在骗你
subTitle:
浮亏50%的人在看什么？在看「历史最高价」，心里念叨：回到我的成本，
我就走。注意，这个想法里全是执念，没有逻辑。市场不知道你的成本价，
它只认当下的供需。

扛起单之后，你会自动收集利好、屏蔽利空，这叫确认偏误。你会觉得
「这次不一样」，这五个字，历史上烧掉的钱比任何黑客都多。

解药其实很简单，但很难做到：开仓前就写好「什么情况下这笔单的逻辑
失效」，到点执行，不看心情。把决策从持有中剥离出来，你才能看清
盘面在说什么，而不是你想听什么。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Your brain is deceiving you when you hold on to a losing trade
translatedData.subTitle:
What does someone who’s down 50% look at? The all-time high. They keep telling themselves, “If it gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” But notice: this thought is all attachment, no logic. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to supply and demand right now.

Once you’re stuck holding a losing position, you automatically seek out bullish news and block out bearish news. This is called confirmation bias. You start thinking,
“This time is different.” Those five words have cost more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is simple in theory, but hard to put into practice: before you enter a trade, write down exactly what would invalidate the reasoning behind it,
and follow through when that point is reached, regardless of how you feel. Separate your decision-making from holding the position, and you’ll be able to see clearly.

I've been watching the ETH 4-hour chart for two days, and there's something really strange around 2500: every time it bounces up to this level, an invisible hand pushes it back down—up once, pushed down once; up again, pushed down again.

This doesn't look like a bottom forming. It looks more like the big players are using sideways action to build a continuation platform for the bears. The moving averages make it even clearer: EMA10 is at 2546, EMA20 at 2572, and EMA30 at 2563. All three are overhead, and price can't even touch the shortest one. Volume keeps shrinking, too. This kind of bounce is a classic dead-cat bounce, designed to trick people who think “it can't fall any further” into buying the dip.

From 2806 down to 2406, then back up to 2500: sharp drop—weak bounce—another drop. The rhythm is perfectly consistent: a textbook downtrend channel.

Given this structure, as long as price can't get above 2600, the bearish trend remains intact. A bounce to 2520-2550 is actually an opportunity to add to short positions. Put the stop-loss above 2600; the first target is 2406, and if that breaks, look straight to 2300.

The direction is already written on the candlestick chart. All that's left is whether you believe it.
